ac1.command:
cd backend
FAIL=0
for i in $(seq 1 10); do
  ENV=development DATABASE_URL=sqlite:///./test.db JWT_SECRET=t35repro-0123456789-abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz-abcd1234 STAFF_PIN=0000 TZ=UTC ./.venv/Scripts/python.exe -m pytest tests/test_log_hygiene.py tests/test_db_atomicity.py -q -p no:randomly || FAIL=1
done
git checkout -- test.db
if [ $FAIL -eq 0 ]; then echo "ac1 ok: 10/10 consecutive pair runs green"; else echo "ac1 FAIL: a pair run was not green"; exit 1; fi
ac1.note: 10/10 consecutive pair runs green, each "8 passed, 2 xfailed" (~1.1s); no disk I/O error or setup error. Executed in the first (pre-timeout) session; not re-run on resume per orchestrator instruction.
